Chapter 1
 This novel follows Elizabeth Bennet, the second of five daughters in a country family in England, as she meets the proud and wealthy Mr Darcy. Their first impressions of each other are poor.
 The story turns on manners, marriage and money. Mrs Bennet wants her daughters married well because the family estate will pass to a cousin.
Chapter 2
 Over the course of the novel Elizabeth learns that her judgement of Darcy was formed by prejudice, and Darcy learns that his pride has hurt others. The book is often read as a comedy of manners and a study of courtship in Regency England.

Ama Owusu and Kofi Boateng https://doi.org/10.5555/ipes.2024.017 People keep thousands of files on their phones but describe almost none of them. We study how automatically drafted catalogue records, reviewed by the owner, change how often people find what they look for.

Mobile-first metadata for personal archives
Ama Owusu and Kofi Boateng
https://doi.org/10.5555/ipes.2024.017

People keep thousands of files on their phones but describe almost none of them. We
study how automatically drafted catalogue records, reviewed by the owner, change how
often people find what they look for.



In a two-week diary study, participants who reviewed drafted records found known items
faster. We discuss the role of Dublin Core and MARC 21 for personal collections and the
risk of trusting automatic metadata without review.

A thesis by Yaw Darko, 2019 This thesis examines how changes in rainfall affected cocoa yields on smallholder farms between 2005 and 2018. Farm records from forty farmers were compared with weather station data.

Cocoa Yields and Rainfall in the Ashanti Region
A thesis by Yaw Darko, 2019

This thesis examines how changes in rainfall affected cocoa yields on smallholder farms
between 2005 and 2018. Farm records from forty farmers were compared with weather
station data.



Yields fell in years with a long dry season, and farms with shade trees lost less of
their harvest. The study recommends shade planting and better access to farm credit.

# Jollof Rice (Ghana style)

By Auntie Esi, 2024

Ingredients: rice, tomatoes, onions, pepper, tomato paste, oil, stock and spices.

Fry the onions, add the blended tomatoes and pepper and cook down until the oil rises. Add stock and washed rice, cover tightly and cook on low heat until the rice is soft. Serve with fried chicken or fish.

By Dr. K. Asamoah, 2026-09-21

A stack is last in, first out. A queue is first in, first out. A hash table maps keys to buckets with a hash function; when two keys share a bucket we have a collision.
